description: Add a GET /greeting endpoint to the small server in src/server.ts. The endpoint reads the `name` query parameter and returns JSON { "greeting": "Hello, <name>" }. When the name is missing or empty, use "world" as the default. Put the route handler in a new file src/routes/greeting.ts and call it from src/server.ts's router. The tests in tests/greeting.test.ts describe the expected behavior and currently fail; make them pass while keeping tests/health.test.ts green.
